note: Web search stopped after 13 searches (the session's allowance ran out), so most findings come from pages opened directly: governments' own board, court and directory pages, Wikipedia, the Michigan Democratic Party's site, and campaign addresses that were guessed and then checked. No party's own endorsement page could be found without search, so endorsed_by is empty throughout. The Governor's appointment releases on the state's site answer scripts 403 and were not used (Sabree, Patel). Candidates with nothing beyond the name were either not on their government's page or could not be looked up.
